rule: §8 gate per candidate: eligible iff its paired validation Δ̄_lin vs G* (H1/M0, the W1 look's G-star) has CI lower bound > 0 (L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum). Among eligible candidates the paired-difference one-SE rule (§9) picks the first candidate in spec order (D10, simplest first: (1) H1+B-loo/M0, (2) H1/M2(f=1), (3) H1+B-loo/M2(f=1)) whose Δ̄_lin(best − candidate) <= its bootstrap SE; that cell is P1 (§10.1 steps 3-4, A12c). If none is eligible, P1 is the best point estimate labelled 'gate not passed'. σ·√(2 ln m) with m = 3 is reported. H2 cells are descriptive (never P1).
